Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We tabbed to every element, pressed Enter or Space on each custom control, and looked for anything a mouse can use that the keyboard cannot; we found nothing a keyboard user would miss. "Earth Information Center (EIC)" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "NASA satellites provide data on Earth's land, ecosystems,..." (link) goes to the same place and can. "What's New with Earth Today" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "Arctic sea ice minimum 1979-2021, with graph" (link) goes to the same place and can. "Climate Essentials" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "Annual Arctic Sea Ice Minimum from 1979 to 2008." (link) goes to the same place and can. "NASA Earth Science" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "Monthly frames (720x480 resolution) of global carbon diox..." (link) goes to the same place and can. "NASA and Agriculture Video" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "Complete transcript available. Music credit: “The Grand J..." (link) goes to the same place and can. "Amazon Deforestation Trends" (link) can't be reached with the keyboard, but "This animation begins by showing the similar sizes betwee..." (link) goes to the same place and can. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).
